maddeler.e:
دررت (form I)
# دَرَرْتُ (darartu) /da.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of دَرَّ (darra)
# دَرَرْتَ (dararta) /da.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of دَرَّ (darra)
# دَرَرْتِ (dararti) /da.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of دَرَّ (darra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
